findings.problem: Service startup could race listeners still holding assigned ports and report Ready without a working server.
findings.fix: Await service listener handoff while retaining an independent ownership lease; probe readiness before summary.
findings.regression: test/runtime.test.js: zero-config startup and readiness timeout

findings.problem: Blanket environment filtering removed existing auth settings and NODE_ENV from unchanged applications.
findings.fix: Preserve inherited environment; allow explicit per-service excludeEnv; never serialize inherited values to state.
findings.regression: test/core.test.js: application environments; test/runtime.test.js: environment preservation

findings.problem: Fragmented registration, duplicate checkouts, stale PID state and idle cleanup were unreliable.
findings.fix: Bounded framed/versioned protocol, authenticated leases, canonical worktree identity, supervisor stop and cancelled idle shutdown.
findings.regression: test/core.test.js: control registration; test/runtime.test.js: parallel and simultaneous starts

findings.problem: Detached service processes could survive abrupt foreground launcher death.
findings.fix: Gateway tracks child ownership on live leases and reaps owned groups when a lease closes.
findings.limitation: Native Windows execution remains unverified locally; Windows cannot simulate POSIX SIGKILL.

findings.problem: Excalidraw uses nested workspace start scripts and an install-then-vite chain rather than a root dev command.
findings.fix: Discover start fallback and safely inspect common nested workspace delegation while preserving the original script.

findings.problem: A fixed localhost OAuth callback loses the initiating worktree and its host-only state/PKCE cookies.
findings.fix: Opt-in in-memory state relay returns observed fixed callbacks to their named origin without changing provider redirect_uri.
findings.limitation: Tested with Better Auth and a local S256 PKCE provider; form_post, hidden/compressed authorization URLs and external providers remain unsupported or untested.

findings.problem: An unchanged auth configuration pinned to localhost rejects a named worktree origin.
findings.limitation: The relay cannot override an application's explicit trust policy. Benzo preserves the 403 instead of disabling origin/CSRF validation.

findings.problem: Documenso and Plane use orchestrators and require a database-backed baseline.
findings.limitation: Docker is absent here. Automatic orchestrator service/port/dependency inference is not implemented; explicit external service configs are supported. Full application journeys remain unimplemented.

findings.problem: Windows package-manager .cmd shims cannot be treated as ordinary Unix executables.
findings.fix: Use cross-spawn for argv-based platform execution and the native tree terminator for cleanup.

findings.problem: Simultaneous explicitly named launches fell back to checkout folder names instead of numeric suffixes.
findings.fix: Carry the unsuffixed requested base name through gateway registration.

findings.problem: The npm bin symlink exited without running the CLI because argv and the module realpath differed.
findings.fix: Canonicalize the entrypoint before checking whether to run main.
findings.regression: test/runtime.test.js: npm-style bin symlink; compatibility/run.mjs: installed bin and package exports

findings.problem: Long persisted collision labels could lose their numeric suffix, and byte-fragmented Unicode control messages could corrupt checkout names.
findings.fix: Preserve up to one DNS label for an existing preferred name and decode TCP control streams as UTF-8.
findings.regression: test/core.test.js: long collision names and Unicode framing

findings.problem: Remix vite:dev was treated as an unknown script, losing explicit host/strict-port forwarding.
findings.fix: Detect Remix Vite development scripts and preserve the original command with Vite-supported flags.
findings.regression: test/core.test.js: zero-config discovery; compatibility state-in-url Remix lane

findings.problem: Wireit and recursive pnpm orchestration could be treated as one server; a Portless-wrapped Vite command could be wrapped twice.
findings.fix: Detect orchestration before framework matching and reject direct Portless wrappers with a diagnostic selecting the original command.
findings.limitation: A diagnostic is not zero-setup integration; root state-in-url/Sokosumi orchestration remains unsupported.

findings.problem: Sokosumi explicitly requires HTTPS origins on port 443; Benzo exposes HTTP only.
findings.limitation: No authenticated baseline established. TLS, trust diagnostics and full service URL/cookie semantics must pass before claiming replacement.

findings.problem: Nested workspace apps without their own packageManager or lockfile fell back to npm despite a pnpm workspace root.
findings.fix: Discover the nearest ancestor package-manager declaration or lockfile while preserving package-local choices.
findings.regression: test/core.test.js: workspace package-manager inheritance; state-in-url Next worktree lanes

findings.problem: Astro interprets duplicate --port options as an array and falls back to 4321, so unchanged scripts already using PORT fail behind Benzo.
findings.fix: For Astro scripts already binding --port to PORT, preserve that binding and append only the host option.
findings.regression: test/core.test.js: Astro PORT binding; compatibility state-in-url astro lane
findings.limitation: This fix targets existing supported PORT bindings. Arbitrary fixed-port wrapper scripts still need an explicit launch configuration.
